note: QUARTERLY reconciliation layer, not daily flow. Coin quantities as tagged by each trust in its own 10-Q/10-K, one value per period end, latest filing wins. Lag is up to 45 days after quarter end (10-K: 90). Spot bitcoin ETPs are 1933-Act grantor trusts and do not file N-PORT. Never merged into the daily holdings series; where a daily figure exists for a period end, the two are compared and the difference published. The concept is found by rule (see edgar.py); first-run output should be read once against a filing before the figures are quoted.
